nodes.name: Electrolyte Preparation
nodes.procedure: 0.024 M FeSO₄·7H₂O, 0.7 M NiSO₄·6H₂O, 0.26 M H₃BO₃, 0.0075 M NH₄Cl, 0.00057 M C₆H₈O₆, 0.01 M CH₃(CH₂)₁₁OSO₃Na, and 0.004 M C₇H₅NO₃S were added to 400 mL of DI water and stirred for 20 h. The Ni:Fe mol ratio was 29:1, and the pH of the electrolyte was 2.
nodes.source_text: Preparation of NiFe@NiFe LDH (NNF): To obtain NiFe@NiFe LDH, 0.024 M FeSO4·7H2O, 0.7 M NiSO4·6H2O... were added to 400 mL of DI water and stirred for 20 h.

nodes.name: NiFe@NiFe LDH Electrodeposition
nodes.procedure: After fully dissolving these precursors, electrodeposition was performed at 5 A dm⁻² (50 mA cm⁻²) for 120 s using a potentiostat (BioLogic, VSP) in two-electrode cells, including a counter electrode composed of a Pt plate (99.99% purity, 2 × 2 cm²) and a working electrode of carbon paper (1 × 1 cm²).

unit_operations.name: Electrodeposition
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: electrodeposition was performed at 5 A dm⁻² (50 mA cm⁻²) for 120 s

nodes.source_text: electrodeposition was performed at 5 A dm⁻²(50 mA cm⁻²) for 120 s using a potentiostat... Pt plate (99.99% purity, 2 × 2 cm²) and a working electrode of carbon paper (1 × 1 cm²)

nodes.name: Dipping Washing and Drying (NNF-D)
nodes.procedure: As-obtained NiFe@NiFe LDH on carbon paper was washed using DI water by dipping method for 7 s and dried for 1 h in a forced convection dry oven at ≈60 °C.
nodes.source_text: As-obtained NiFe@NiFe LDH on carbon paper was washed using DI water and dried for 1 h... one involved only dipping in DI water for 7 s

nodes.name: Flowing Washing and Drying (NNF-W-7s)
nodes.procedure: As-obtained NiFe@NiFe LDH on carbon paper was washed using flowing DI water for 7 s and dried for 1 h in a forced convection dry oven at ≈60 °C.
nodes.source_text: the other was a washing method involving flowing DI water... The washing times when using flowing DI water were 7, 10, and 60 s.

nodes.name: Ni@Ni(OH)₂ Electrodeposition
nodes.procedure: Ni@Ni(OH)₂ was deposited on carbon paper without the presence of FeSO₄·7H₂O. The other electrodeposition conditions were the same.
nodes.source_text: Ni@Ni(OH)₂ was deposited on carbon paper without the presence of FeSO₄·7H₂O. The other electrodeposition conditions were the same.

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD pattern of NNF-D matches Ni₃Fe, Ni(OH)₂, NiSO₄·6H₂O, and FeSO₄·7H₂O phases with specific crystal planes identified including Ni₃Fe (200) at 51.75° and (220) at 76.15°, NiFe LDH (001) at 19.0°.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Figure 1b shows the X-ray diffraction (XRD) pattern of NNF-D on the carbon paper, which matches with that of Ni₃Fe (ICSD 98-063-2930), Ni(OH)₂ (ICSD 98-010-9391), NiSO₄·6H₂O (ICSD 98-002-4140), and FeSO₄·7H₂O (ICSD 98-028-0578).

nodes.characterization_summary: Raman peaks at 979-987 cm⁻¹ confirm NiSO₄·6H₂O, FeSO₄·7H₂O, and intercalated SO₄²⁻; peaks at 458 and 535 cm⁻¹ correspond to Niᴵᴵ-OH and Niᴵᴵ-O.
nodes.evidence_snippet: A peak of 979-987 cm⁻¹ was examined, indicating the presence of NiSO₄·6H₂O and FeSO₄·7H₂O, and intercalated SO₄²⁻ anion, as shown in Figure 1c.

properties.description: Upper spectrum after stability test at 10 mA/cm² for 100h

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM shows amorphous phase (halo ring in SAD pattern), NiFe layer thickness ≈242 nm, Ni/Fe sulfate layer 9-16 nm, NiFe LDH layer ≈5-8 nm; HR-TEM confirms d-spacings 0.46, 0.95, 0.35, 0.54 nm corresponding to NiFe LDH, NiFeOOH, NiSO₄·6H₂O, FeSO₄·7H₂O.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The NiFe and Ni and Fe sulfate layer thicknesses are ≈242 and 9-16 nm, respectively. The NiFe LDH layer thickness was ≈5-8 nm (Figure S8c,d, Supporting Information) and d-spacings of 0.46, 0.95, 0.35, and 0.54 nm corresponding to NiFe LDH, NiFeOOH, NiSO₄·6H₂O, and FeSO₄·7H₂O were confirmed.

properties.description: Grayscale micrograph showing circular particle with granular texture

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM-EDS mapping confirms uniform distribution of Ni, Fe, S, O elements with Ni and Fe sulfate residues adequately covering NNF-D surface.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Figure 1d-i exhibits the EDS mapping results of NNF-D. Ni, Fe, S, and O were detected in the EDS mapping results, indicating that Ni and Fe sulfate residues adequately covered the NNF-D surface.

properties.visualized: black bar at bottom of image

nodes.characterization_summary: ICP-MS confirms composition Ni₈₉.₅Fe₁₀.₅ for NNF-D and Ni₈₉.₉Fe₁₀.₁ for NNF-W-7 s.
nodes.evidence_snippet: We confirmed the exact composition of NNF-D and NNF-W-7 s using inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometry (ICP-MS). NNF-D exhibited a slightly higher Fe content than NNF-W.

nodes.characterization_summary: XPS shows Ni 2p peaks at 855.5, 857.3, 861.4 eV (Ni²⁺, Ni³⁺, satellite), Fe 2p at 711.6 eV (Fe³⁺), O 1s at 530.0, 530.9, 532.4 eV (O²⁻, OH⁻, H₂O+SO₄²⁻), S 2p at 168-171 eV (SO₄²⁻); S content decreases from 14 at% (NNF-D) to 5.9 at% (NNF-W-60 s).
nodes.evidence_snippet: For Ni 2p, peaks at 855.5, 857.3, and 861.4 eV were detected, which corresponded to Ni²⁺, Ni³⁺, and the satellite peak, respectively.

nodes.characterization_summary: FTIR ATR confirms free SO₄²⁻ peaks at 1043, 1109 cm⁻¹ and interlayer SO₄²⁻ at 1120 cm⁻¹ indicating sulfate counter anions in NiFe LDH.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The peaks of free at 1043 and 1109 cm⁻¹, as well as interlayer SO₄²⁻ at 1120 cm⁻¹ ions, are confirmed using Fourier transform infrared spectrometer attenuated total reflection (FTIR ATR, Figure S2).

nodes.characterization_summary: GI-XRD after stability test shows phase transformation from NiFe LDH to NiFeOOH with peaks at 19.4°, 35.8°, 39.25°, 40.8° for (002), (110), (004), (11-2) planes.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The phase transformation from NiFe LDH (ICSD 98-010-9391) to NiFeOOH (ICSD 98-016-5961) was determined using GI-XRD, as depicted in Figure 3a.

nodes.characterization_summary: SEM shows spherical morphology of NNF-D with porous structure and sulfate layer coverage.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The surface morphology of NNF-D was spherical (Figure S5, Supporting Information). The NNF-D sample was covered with a sulfate layer (Figure S5a, Supporting Information) and had a porous structure (Figure S4b, Supporting Information).

nodes.characterization_summary: EDS confirms presence of S in NNF-W-7 s and composition Ni₇₈Fe₂₂.
nodes.evidence_snippet: S was detected in the energy-dispersive X-ray (EDS) spectrum in Figure S6c (Supporting Information), and the composition of NNF-W-7 s was Ni₇₈Fe₂₂.
